text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, June 23 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 5 vessels due by 25/7, no delays.
Hay Point - One vessel loading, 2 waiting, 10 due by 8/7, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 16 due by 7/7, no delays.
Gladstone - Curragh mine still on strike. Gordonstone returned to work 20/6 p.m.
R.G. Tanna - 2 Vessels loading, 20 due by 25/7, no delays.
Barney Point - Berth vacant, 7 vessels due by 25/7, no delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant, 2 vessels due by 30/6, no delays.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Repairs to dyke loader no.3 container until 29/6. Until repairs are completed, no vessels can berth at no. 4. Loader 1 and 2 will operate as normal at dyke 5 until no. 4 can be used. Hunter valley no.1 workers voted to extend the strike for a further 2 weeks until 8/7. Management are endeavouring to force the unions to return to work/negotiate. No force majeure declared by shippers who will continue to load with available grades.

Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 11 waiting, 18 due by 5/7, 1 day delay. Dyke 4+5 - 1 Vessel loading, 9 waiting, 24 due by 8/7, 6-7 days delay. Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 2 waiting, 26 due by 26/8.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Berth A - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored, 3 due by 25/6. Berth b - Will be shut down for approx. 60 hours for conveyor belt changeover. 3 Vessels anchored, 2 due by 25/6.
Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - 1 Vessel loading, 1 due.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored, 2 due by 24/6.
E.I. Island - 1 Vessel loading. Berth maintenance for 24 hours. 5 Vessels anchored, 18 due.
Port Walcott - Maintenance shut down, resumption of work 24/6 a.m. 4 Vessels anchored, 18 due.
June 25 - Grain - QUEENSLAND - Mackay, Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - One wheat vessel in port, 2 wheat vessels due by 30/6.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading wheat, 2 wheat vessels in port, 1 wheat vessel due 30/6.
Sydney - No further grain loading expected at this port.
Port Kembla - Four grain vessels in port, 3 wheat vessels due. Berthing programme based on grade of cargo receivals by rail.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One vessel loading wheat, 2 wheat vessels due by 22/7.
Portland - One vessel loading peas, 3 vessels due by 5/7.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One wheat vessel in port.
Port Adelaide - Two vessels due by 29/6.
Thevenard - No vessels due.
Port Lincoln - Two vessels due by 29/6.
Wallaroo - One wheat vessel due 26/6.
Ardrossan, Port Giles - No vessels due.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Two vessels loading wheat, 1 wheat vessel in port, 4 vessels due by 7/7.
Kwinana - Two vessels loading of which 1 wheat, 1 lupins. 8 Vessels due by 9/7.
Albany - Two vessels due by 28/6.
Esperance - Two vessels due by 29/6 of which 1 for lupins, 1 canola.
